description:
Zoey Deutch, Jesse Eisenberg, Allison Janney, Jeff Bridges, and Bobby Moynihan go around the horn answering questions about their upcoming animated film, 'Minions & Monsters'!  Zoey Deutch gives a master class in "Minionese", Jeff Bridges talks about how the movie is all about love, and they run down some of their favorite classic movies!  See 'Minions & Monsters' in theaters July 1!
